text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, huh? When did you get back...?! ...-Wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-Hmph! Instructor put you up to this, right?!
choice_data_list: No, I want to know more about you
No, I want to know more about you

text_block_list.text: Misunderstood because knew nothing about Shinko Windy. Never properly talked once.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Can't fool me, probably—... huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Want to know more about Windy-chan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmmmm. ...Well, if begging that hard.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Everything?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Shi-shi-shi! Helpless human! Listen up to legend of Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan awesome ever since birth!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dad, Mom, company employees—everyone praised Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Windy's Mom
text_block_list.text: Oh, Windy-chan! Eating sweets so cute! Pure genius~!

text_block_list.name: Windy's Dad
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, Windy always bouncing around full of energy! World-class treasure!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But... realized in kindergarten... world super weird!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So weird! Eat food, wake from nap, put on shoes—nobody praises!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No matter what done, nobody looks!
Isn't that normal? Swallowed retort... kept quiet and listened.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No matter how I think about it, it's super weird! Even though Windy-chan is the number one absolute best in the whole wide world……

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why, since I had no choice, I just had to stand out all on my own! Watching everyone's reactions, trying all kinds of stuff, and then――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Surprising everyone and hogging all the spotlight! Becoming the ultimate bad guy that even heroes have to chase after!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gaooo~! So I decided to become a super evil villain!
As I thought, Shinko Windy's whole reason for causing mischief was simply \"I want to stand out\" and \"I want everyone looking at me.\"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I went super-duper wild, and pranking everyone was a total blast! ……But then I realized, just doing that wasn't gonna cut it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If it's just pranks, everyone gets bored super fast. If I want them to keep looking at me way, way, waaaay longer, pranks aren't enough!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why I checked out all kinds of places…… and found a place where the cheers were super loud!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: And she crosses the finish line first! A truly brilliant victory!
(Waaaaaaaah—!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A-amazing…… everyone, literally every single person…… is looking only at her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's the place where Windy-chan belongs! It's so flashy! The cheering is crazy loud!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why Windy-chan is gonna run in the Twinkle Series! To become the most amazing Uma Musume of all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……Hmph! This place is totally messed up! Compared to back then, barely anyone is watching me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
…………
Fast ones, strong ones, crazy amazing ones.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Obviously Windy-chan is way cooler than them! But, but…… they're…… pretty incredible too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: …………Nobody told me there'd be girls like that around.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
……~~~ So annoying! Annoying! Annoying!
I-if it's gonna be like this……!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Then someone like Windy-chan might as well……!
……Tracen Academy is a school where natural geniuses gather. A place capable of breaking the pride of even the most confident Uma Musume.
It quietly chips away at your spirit before you even notice. The escalation of her mischievous antics was actually a desperate cry for help――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've made up my mind!
I quit!
Before I could even think, my hand reached out and grabbed her arm.
Even if I had misunderstood some details…… there was no question that her troublemaking stemmed from a pure desire for recognition.
If she builds her strength through proper training, the results will follow. The fact that she was pushed this far was partly my responsibility too.
She definitely has the raw talent. Steer her right, and she can run with pure joy again. I wondered if I could be the one to help her――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-…… What's your problem? You don't want Windy-chan to quit?
Hearing her ask that, I knew this was my chance.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What are you blurting out all of a sudden――
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your future!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……Hehehe, ku-ku-ku-ku!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha ha ha ha!
Wahahaha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right, exactly right!
Windy-chan is super awesome, super cool, and the absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So in the next race, no doubt about it……!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun, darn right you will!
